data.description: Panel F6/N2 (ticket 0734). The INC-015 recovery text says 'checkout your feature branch and re-run' but omits that a merged source branch is SPENT (merged-PR-guarded) and a FRESH branch is required, the orphaned staged ref must be removed, and SHAs change so a full re-review is required. Make the recovery path DETECT spent-source and emit the blocking guidance, not just describe the happy path. Ref: 588e-backlog-reconciliation-plan.md N2.
data.title: merge-to-main: re-stage recovery message must BLOCK spent-branch reuse (detect spent source; instruct fresh-branch + orphaned-staged cleanup + re-review-required)
